title: PBR Anti-Aliasing Matrix: Five Methods at Four Quality Levels
teaches: Compare FXAA, SMAA, MSAA, TAA and SSAA intent across Low, Medium, High and Ultra quality using discrete two-second Scene.renderStyle cuts.
Keep physical shading, camera, geometry and lighting fixed so anti-aliasing policy is the only RenderStyle variable.
Observe requested-versus-effective fallback behaviour for methods not implemented by the active immediate-preview backend.
